physics_goals.quote: Due to this feature, it could be used not only for the reactor monitoring, but also for fundamental research including short-range neutrino oscillations to the sterile state.
physics_goals.value: Search for short-baseline oscillations of reactor antineutrinos to a sterile neutrino and monitor reactor operation, using a movable solid-scintillator spectrometer a few metres from an industrial reactor core

summary.plain: A movable one-cubic-metre block of plastic scintillator strips placed a few metres below an industrial reactor at the Kalinin power plant in Russia. By comparing antineutrino spectra at three distances since 2016 it has looked for, and so far excluded, much of the parameter space for a sterile neutrino.
summary.technical: Highly segmented (2500 strips, Gd-loaded reflective cover) 1 m^3 plastic-scintillator IBD detector on a lifting platform under a 3.1 GW_th VVER-1000 core at 10.7/11.7/12.7 m, ~50 m.w.e. overburden, ~5000 antineutrinos/day at the closest position. Spectral ratios between distances exclude sin^2(2 theta_14) < 0.01 in the most sensitive region (2018).
